content: Participated in an intensive, industry-led cloud computing training program. Collaborated in a cross-functional team to architect and deploy the backend infrastructure for our capstone project, "Parental Peace," utilizing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to bridge machine learning models with a mobile frontend.
content_id: Berpartisipasi dalam program pelatihan cloud computing intensif yang dipimpin oleh industri. Berkolaborasi dalam tim lintas divisi untuk merancang dan melakukan deployment infrastruktur backend proyek capstone "Parental Peace", memanfaatkan Google Cloud Platform (GCP) untuk menjembatani model machine learning dengan antarmuka aplikasi mobile.
